_comment: Raises arkdevnet_9000-1's unbonding period from 300s to 21 days so IBC
light clients can hold a viable trusting period (~14 days).
DECIDED 2026-09-03: make the devnet mainnet-shaped rather than stand up a
second network. This trades away the ability to exercise unbonding,
redelegation and slashing-during-unbonding inside a working session — the
documented reason the 300s value existed. If those scenarios need
rehearsing again, use a throwaway chain rather than reverting this.
NOTE: the unbonding period governs converting BONDED stake back to liquid.
It does not affect sending liquid balances, paying gas, or withdrawing
validator rewards and commission — all of which stay instant.
MsgUpdateParams replaces the params struct wholesale — every field must be
present, not just the one being changed. Values below are the live devnet
params with unbonding_time changed and nothing else.
Submit:  arkd tx gov submit-proposal staking-unbonding-21d.json \
title: Raise staking unbonding period to 21 days for IBC interoperability
summary: Raises unbonding_time from 300s to 1814400s (21 days), matching the mainnet-locked figure from decision #10, so IBC light clients on counterparty chains can be created with a viable trusting period. Trades away the devnet's fast unbonding/slashing test cycle.
